title: tte
description: Time to exhaustion at a power the CALLER names (#187), from the same CP model `power-curve` publishes. `status` is the honest qualifier: `in_model` (2-20 minutes, where the two-parameter model holds), `outside_model` (the number is real arithmetic but the model overshoots there — read it as a direction), or `below_cp` (at or under CP the model says indefinitely, which is the model's answer and not the athlete's). `known` here means only that the arithmetic ran — it is NOT the usual licence to trust the magnitude; `status` is what qualifies the number. Weigh the fit with `demonstrated_*` before anything else: it is the longest effort at or above `watts` the athlete has ON RECORD in the same window the fit was built from, so `contradicts_model: true` means the model predicts less than its own inputs already prove and understates this rider. `fit_points` counts how many of the 5/10/20-minute bests were available (max 3) and cannot detect a degenerate fit on its own.
